title: Build layer: System 7.5.5
note: Mac OS 7.5.5 as baked from Apple's installers (os-7.5.5) with the tools every other bake needs in the guest: Open Transport 1.1.2 (networking, as 7.6.1 has built in), StuffIt Expander (expand bakes) and Disk Copy (floppy sets, disk images), in Utilities. The base for 7.5.5 bakes (bases.json tools-7.5.5).
